# Contributing to Nanolog

Questions go to [Discussions Q&A](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/discussions/categories/q-a), bugs and ideas to [issues](https://github.com/nanolaba/nanolog/issues/new/choose); see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md). A pull request is welcome for a bug with an issue, or for an idea agreed in its issue first: Nanolog stays one small jar on purpose, so a new feature is discussed before it is written.

## Build and test

```shell
mvn verify -Dgpg.skip=true -Dcheck=true
```

- The `test` phase runs JUnit and then pitest with a 100% mutation threshold: every change to the code of the library needs tests that kill its mutants. A mutant that no test can kill means the code can be simpler.
- For a quick loop, run the tests without pitest: `mvn test-compile surefire:test -Dtest=SomeTest`.
- The library targets Java 8; do not use newer APIs. CI builds on JDK 8, 11, 17 and 21; Javadoc is built on JDK 8 too, which rejects what newer JDKs accept.
- CI also runs the tests against SLF4J 1.7 (`-P slf4j-1.7`), compiles Kotlin callers (`-P kotlin`, JDK 17) and builds a jlink image with the jar (`sh src/it/jlink/run.sh`, JDK 11+).

## Documentation

- `README.md`, `README.ru.md`, `llms.txt`, `skills/nanolog/SKILL.md` and the `SUPPORT`, `CONTRIBUTING` and `SECURITY` files are generated by the readme-generator Maven plugin from the `*.src.md` files beside them. Edit the sources and run `mvn compile`; `-Dcheck=true` fails the build when a generated file is stale.
- The sources of the README and of these files hold English and Russian side by side, so a change is made in both languages at once; `agent-guide.src.md` is English only.
- The code samples of the README are imported from `src/test/java/com/nanolaba/logging/examples` and compiled with the tests, so they cannot go stale.
- A new setting goes into a settings table of the README: a test fails otherwise.

## Pull requests

- One change per pull request, with its tests and its documentation, and `Closes #N` for its issue.
- Nanolog has no dependencies at run time and must not get any.
- Coding agents read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), which describes the architecture and the rules in detail; people may find it useful too.
- By contributing you agree that your contribution is licensed under the [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE).
